user_stories.title: Workflow start and resume return 202 immediately with no Redis dependency
user_stories.statement: drift-api should return 202 Accepted with workflowId and CREATED status immediately when a workflow is started, and 202 with RUNNING when resumed, without any Redis blocking or pub/sub
user_stories.demo_script: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v3/workflow/start -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"issueDetail":{...}}' — assert 202 response with body {"workflowId":"...","workflowStatus":"CREATED"} returned in <50ms; curl -X PUT http://localhost:8000/v3/workflow/resume/{id} — assert 202 with {"workflowId":"...","workflowStatus":"RUNNING"}
acceptance_tests: POST /v3/workflow/start returns 202 with workflowId and workflowStatus=CREATED
PUT /v3/workflow/resume/{id} returns 202 with workflowStatus=RUNNING
callbackUrl with ftp:// scheme returns 400 INVALID_CALLBACK_URL
callbackUrl=null accepted without validation error
API service starts without redisConfiguration in YAML
No redis.clients.* import anywhere in api module
publishNode() writes to HBase only — no Redis calls

user_stories.title: Workflow completion triggers HTTP callback to caller-provided URL
user_stories.statement: drift-worker should POST a callback payload to callbackUrl when a workflow reaches a terminal state (COMPLETED, FAILED, DELEGATED, ASYNC_COMPLETE), with Temporal retry semantics and callback failure causing workflow failure
user_stories.demo_script: Start a workflow with callbackUrl pointing to a webhook listener; complete the workflow; assert HTTP POST received at callbackUrl with JSON body {workflowId, workflowStatus, errorMessage} and headers X-Drift-Workflow-Id + X-Drift-Callback-Event
acceptance_tests: CallbackActivityImpl POSTs JSON body with workflowId, workflowStatus, errorMessage to callbackUrl
X-Drift-Workflow-Id header set to workflowId
X-Drift-Callback-Event header is WORKFLOW_COMPLETED for COMPLETED and ASYNC_COMPLETE
X-Drift-Callback-Event header is WORKFLOW_FAILED for FAILED status
HTTP 4xx from target causes non-retryable ActivityFailure
HTTP 5xx from target causes retryable ActivityFailure (Temporal retries up to 3 times)
Workflow with no callbackUrl completes normally without any callback
WAITING state does not trigger callback
Callback failure (all retries exhausted) causes workflow to be marked FAILED

user_stories.title: Redis fully removed from codebase, dependencies, and config
user_stories.statement: drift should build and run with zero Redis/Jedis code, configuration, or Maven dependencies — Redis Sentinel is no longer an infrastructure requirement

WorkflowNodeExecutor.invokeCallbackIfPresent(String workflowId, WorkflowState workflowState) is a new private method: returns immediately if callbackUrl is null or blank; builds CallbackPayload{workflowId, workflowStatus, errorMessage}; creates Workflow.newActivityStub(CallbackActivity.class, OptionsStore.callbackActivityOptions); calls stub.sendCallback(callbackUrl, payload)

CRITICAL: invokeCallbackIfPresent has NO try-catch wrapper. ActivityFailure propagates if all retries exhausted — Temporal marks workflow FAILED. This is identical to any other Temporal activity failure. The stub.sendCallback() call MUST NOT be wrapped in try-catch.
